items.html: And the reason is that from Bina the judgments are aroused (mit'arin); therefore it does not have the power to receive the portion of the light of the Atik like the Hochma. Therefore the Hochma remained in its place, and the Bina descended into the throat. But in the other Partzufim, such as Aba veIma and ZON, they all receive the light of the Atik through the garment of Arich Anpin, and they have the ability to apprehend it, and there is no need for their Bina to descend and distance itself.
